availability: Unreleased draft source; outcomes do not qualify public packages or runtimes.

profiles.boundary: Stable scalar results are refreshed before Hindi or Arabic shaping in BestEffort/Lenient, retaining editable DOCX fields and reporting known baseline or directional losses.
Strict loss, page/reference and tagged output, cross-field conjuncts, excessive field expansion and cancellation reject without publishing output.
Clustered horizontal bars retain editable workbook data and render signed managed vectors with an explicit plot-area approximation in BestEffort/Lenient.
Strict loss, unsupported gap/axis appearances and native, tagged or archival combinations remain explicit failures.
A dedicated bookmark in an unprotected fixed-grid body cell with complete physical margins can become an editable prepared cross-tab; its nested header does not repeat.
Implicit, partial or ambiguous margins, non-fixed or protected table geometry, unsafe references, overflow and cancellation fail without committing.
Distinct-path mixed body repeats retain nested ownership, scope order and cloned identities across a finite depth; cached descendants keep unique IDs.
Cross-boundary references, configured depth or aggregate row exhaustion fail without committing; existing unsupported object and table owners stay excluded.
An empty ordinary body paragraph can become one of six typed block controls with explicit values, locks, local bindings, subsequent edits and admitted fragment composition.
Nonempty, styled and cell placeholders reject without changing their owner; cancellation remains atomic.
The same preview render can expose bounded, immutable managed body-paragraph glyph boxes and source locations; text remains opt-in.
Unqualified owners retain null bounds and reasons; detached review snapshots and excessive fragment requests fail explicitly.
BestEffort and Lenient native output retain Hindi/Latin text in one-column merged tables with an explicit row-spacing loss; this does not qualify strict or tagged output.
Strict row-spacing parity, right-to-left text, tagged/archive output and oversized vertical groups reject before copying output.
A dedicated plain body bookmark can be replaced with an editable prepared cross-tab, preserving the surrounding blocks and section while checking its column width and repeating header.
Body-bookmark insertion rejects partial, enclosed or cell bookmarks, placeholder references, reentrant data and cancellation without committing a table.
Admitted typed controls retain nested ownership and isolated local XML bindings through repeated body or simple-cell insertion; created control kinds remain editable.
Conflicting glossary resources, date-policy conflicts, report owners, typed-control restyling, resource exhaustion and cancellation fail before committing.
Admitted local glossary entries and compatible resources are copied with new document-local entry identities and placeholder references; conflicting resource bytes reject atomically.
Admitted chart and equation fragments retain editable objects and isolated placement IDs at body or simple-cell bookmarks, using source appearance.
Object fragment restyling, resource exhaustion and cancellation reject atomically; report controls and retained history remain outside this profile.
Separate typed-control and chart/equation paragraph owners can be composed and edited independently in body and simple-cell destinations.
Objects cannot share a typed-control paragraph or be placed inside a structural row or cell control owner; unqualified profiles and cancelled edits leave the session unchanged.
One unbound rich-text wrapper around a plain body-table row or cell retains identity, literal metadata and static display. Structural mutation and nested children remain unsupported.
Structural wrappers with unsupported kinds, placeholders, nested controls, merged cells or unsupported widths, and mutation or binding operations on these owners, reject explicitly.

Immutable definitions create each existing typed kind at an explicit Unicode-safe position in an ordinary unstyled body or simple-cell paragraph. Initial values, locks and explicit existing local bindings remain editable under their declared rules.
Creation rejects invalid definitions, unsafe locations or bindings, existing protected owners, repeat rows and merged or nested tables without mutating the session.
An explicit edit removes an admitted typed wrapper, retaining text by default or deleting it with a valid block shell; admitted body, cell and shared plain story owners remain valid.
Removal honors wrapper and content locks, ancestor protection, dirty bindings and stale handles; the final wrapper cannot be removed while retained local resources remain.

Top-level block or paragraph-inline controls in plain header/footer stories preserve global identity, shared-story ownership and explicit bindings. Default, first and even story selection stays editable and displays as static text.
Story table or nested owners, crossing bookmarks, duplicate or excessive global control IDs and inconsistent shared bindings reject; locks and cancellation preserve the original document.

An unbound, non-placeholder block rich-text parent in the body or a simple cell retains its inline typed children, their IDs and parent identity, order, values, placeholders and explicit local bindings.
Child edits honor parent and child locks; replacing a parent with children, conflicting bindings, deeper nesting and unqualified parent kinds or states reject atomically.

Editable style chains retain qualified conditional borders; isolated outer edges, look flags and a fill-and-border combination match independent LibreOffice colors. Composition, comparison and report expansion retain their bounded semantics.
Conditional interior edges, competing or overlapping borders, inherited rendering and missing look settings remain explicitly unqualified; editable metadata and untouched outputs are checked.
A complete bounded local theme retains clear conditional fill tokens, one tint or shade, and the original fallback in editable DOCX; explicit child fills replace inherited theme references.
Static conditional theme colors differ from LibreOffice's stored fallback; missing themes, conflicting transforms, malformed metadata and changed editable references remain explicit.

Used default table-style definitions and implicit versus explicit table references remain editable in DOCX. Compatible composition and whole-table defaults on newly authored simple tables preserve that identity; unused definitions are not reconstructed.

Explicit table-look masks select first/last row and column, corner and unit-band cell fills; direct clear RGB cell shading wins. Bounded band sizes and style chains remain editable. LibreOffice matches the documented Office overlap order in the tested grids; the OOXML order and Word's documented band default differ and are reported.

Non-DOCX rendering that relies on inherited conditional regions, omitted or non-unit band sizes, single-row/column overlapping first/last regions and nil cell shading remains unqualified. Reference controls retain the inheritance, band-size and degenerate-grid observations.

A qualified explicit table-look mask selects clear first-row cell shading; direct clear RGB cell fills override it. Editable DOCX retains the style chain and look; independent LibreOffice controls verify colors and precedence, with geometry differences remaining.

Static output depending on inherited conditions, conflicting or omitted look semantics, unsupported conditional properties, nil/whole-table shading conflicts, changed style comparison and repeated fixed-page headers reject. Duplicate look or direct cell shading markup fails before output.

Bounded whole-table style chains retain explicit borders and clear RGB shading in editable DOCX; collision-safe composition and report expansion preserve their appearance. Independent LibreOffice fixtures confirm inherited colors and an edge reset, with measured placement differences.

Unqualified default-style rendering, unsupported conditional properties and metadata, direct table or cell conflicts, changed styles in comparison and destination restyling remain explicitly unsupported. Cyclic and overdeep chains fail before output.

Clear explicit RGB table fill is retained in DOCX and painted for simple body cells after row expansion. LibreOffice omitted the table-level fill in the independent probe, so reference parity remains unqualified.
Direct-cell conflicts, unsupported shading, stories, fixed-page repetition/splits and destinations that omit shading reject in strict mode; unexpected border content is diagnosed.

Simple rectangular tables retain explicit direct table borders and recompute outside/inside edges after row expansion. Independent LibreOffice evidence confirms colors and grid relationships while retaining measured placement differences.
Conflicting or merged cells, unsupported stories, repeated/split fixed-page rows and destinations that omit table borders reject in strict mode; duplicate sides fail without writing.

Ordinary body and simple-cell paragraph properties use explicit resolved snapshots, review decisions and schema-valid OOXML when surrounding topology matches. Unchanged matching body paragraphs can also carry format history while other paragraphs are inserted or deleted.

Cell formatting combined with structural edits, formatting on moved paragraphs, unsupported history owners, style-embedded history and exhausted work budgets fail without changing the source sessions; display rejects paragraph-format history.
Optional story-text and supported run-format exclusions retain original matching values while selected text and admitted structural changes are tracked.
Excluded categories do not bypass the existing unsupported formatting or shared-story topology admission checks.
Rectangular unmerged numeric tables refresh admitted local sums and cell dependencies atomically, with explicit invariant percentage pictures.
Unsupported, cyclic, over-limit, blank, text and merged table dependencies reject calculation and retain every source formula cache in the table.
Selected Latin fonts, text colors and direct cell colors resolve for rendering. A reconstructed scheme retains supported text references; unsupported theme semantics remain diagnosed.
Malformed, duplicate and external theme metadata reject; missing or unsupported references retain diagnosed fallbacks.
Macro-free DOTX/OTT package identities, selected exchanges, session editing and bounded byte-based inspection use the existing content profiles.
Mismatched, conflicting, unsafe, macro-bearing and protected identities remain explicit; bounded stream failures retain caller ownership.

A bounded main-document character-style chain on an ordinary typed-control run resolves to direct appearance in non-strict modes; editable style identity is lost with an explicit diagnostic and Strict rejects it.

Typed control glossary categories, selected inert resources including validated notTrueType metadata, and Word-authored rich, plain and date derivatives; unlisted graphs and Strict theme losses remain excluded.
External, unsafe and unadmitted glossary graphs are rejected rather than silently omitted.
Explicit simple body-cell placement and opted-in cached simple fields use the documented identity and style rules.
Unsupported owners, field switches and unresolved references fail atomically.
Explicit detached ordinary managed PDF/SVG display of admitted body and simple-cell text revisions.
The default policy rejects comments and format history; story revisions, controls, source loss, PNG, native and tagged/archive combinations remain excluded.
Explicit numbered end annotations cover classic comments, supported run-format changes and paired whole-paragraph moves in ordinary managed output.
Other structural revisions, exceeded annotation bounds and the existing nonordinary output profiles remain excluded.
Rectangular matrices retain admitted OMML semantics and render with the caller's qualified MATH font in ordinary managed output.
Malformed, over-limit and unadmitted matrix variants fail explicitly; no unqualified math-font fallback is used.
Summation, product and integral expressions retain explicit limits and render with qualified MATH font metrics; insufficient display variants are diagnosed.
Unsupported operators, unqualified document defaults, growth, placeholders and malformed graphs do not silently flatten.
